verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a 5-minute setup that connects GitHub or GitLab, configures review triggers, and delivers automated feedback on the first PR. It automatically reviews every pull request. Its review comments carry file paths and line numbers, take reactions and replies, and are linked from a findings summary, all of which point to native PR comments. A hands-on user confirms it comments on PRs so authors can reply or fix before human review. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the GitHub/GitLab app installation model and of 'inline' comment placement, and a documented or corroborated turnaround time for PR reviews (the 5 minutes covers setup and the 60-second figure covers only the local CLI).
